Set up & run

The .sdlc folder

Everything Sigma remembers about a repository lives in one folder at its root. Some of it belongs in git and some of it must never be.

On this page
  • What lives there
  • Commit or ignore
  • Managing it

Think of .sdlc as two piles. The durable pile is your goals, your settings and the written record of each goal (plan, research, acceptance criteria). It goes in git like code. The machine pile is scratch space the loop rewrites constantly: state, logs, worktrees. It stays out of git. Init sorts them for you; you only need to commit the first pile.

What lives there

.sdlc/
  config.json        machine config; this file wins over the prose in project.md
  project.md         project notes the agents read
  goals/             one markdown file per goal (the local backlog)
  plans/  research/  acceptance/    records kept with the goal that wrote them
  features/          the units-of-work registry, where you use units
  state/             machine-written loop state, review queue, logs, timing
  ledger/            a git worktree of the team ledger branch
  work/              one worktree per goal in flight
  knowledge/  events/               optional graph output and the event journal

Commit or ignore

PathGitWhy
.sdlc/config.jsonCommitThe settings the whole team and every clone share. Without it a clone reads as an unadopted repository and the hooks stay inert.
.sdlc/project.mdCommitContext the agents read at the start of a goal.
.sdlc/goals/CommitIn local-files mode this is the backlog itself.
.sdlc/plans/, research/, acceptance/Commit, with the goal's branchDurable evidence. The pull-request push is refused while a goal's plan exists on disk but is not committed on its branch.
.sdlc/features/Commit where you use unitsThe registry of units of work. See Units of work.
.sdlc/state/IgnoreMachine-written loop state, the review queue, the action log, the timing store, watcher files.
.sdlc/ledger/IgnoreA separate git worktree on its own branch. It must stay out of code pull requests.
.sdlc/work/IgnoreOne worktree per goal in flight.
.sdlc/knowledge/, .sdlc/events/IgnoreRegenerable graph output and the event journal.

Init writes the ignore rules for the runtime folders. Review git status, then commit .gitignore and the durable files.

Never ignore .sdlc as a whole

Ignoring the whole folder hides the config, the goals and the written records from git. Each clone then has no settings and no backlog, the hooks treat the repository as unadopted, and a goal's plan and acceptance record never reach its branch, so the gates that look for them refuse. Ignore only the runtime folders above.

Managing it

You want toDo this
Add or change ignore rulesRun /sigma-setup; it adds the runtime rules and never narrows or overwrites an ignore rule you already set.
Keep tracked files untouchedUse the local-only scope: the rules go in .git/info/exclude instead of .gitignore. Moving existing rules between the two is by hand; Sigma never relocates a rule.
See what is on and what is not/sigma-doctor prints the feature dashboard from your config.
Resume a parked local goalEdit its file under .sdlc/goals/: change status: parked to status: pending. Then delete its entry from .sdlc/state/review-queue.md by hand.
Stop a background watchertouch .sdlc/state/watch.stop. Other loops have their own stop files: supervisor.stop, slack-commands.stop.
Remove SigmaFollow the uninstall guide. It stops daemons first, removes worktrees before deleting .sdlc, and lists the branches to review before you delete any.
Technical detail

The runtime ignore list is .sdlc/state/, .sdlc/ledger/, .sdlc/work/, .sdlc/knowledge/, .sdlc/events/ and a knowledge-graph output folder. Growth worth knowing, with no pruning today: the ledger holds one entry file per writing process (175 were counted for a single actor on one machine after two and a half weeks, a measured audit, not a limit), and the per-goal action logs grow for the life of a goal. A hard plan gate can be bypassed locally by creating .sdlc/.allow-direct-edits unless an organisation has locked the key on in managed settings.
